## WAVE 3 — four parallel agents (disjoint file domains, zero contention)

### Agent A · STATICS / SCENERY — owns `scene3d/statics.js` + `buildings.js` + `cells.js` + `crates/holtburger-scenery-bake/` + `src/lib.rs` (scenery export region)
**V1 — Static scenery/building `default_script` ambient particle chains never run (HIGH, M, default-on).** 36% of SetupModels (2161/5935 in client_portal.dat) carry a `default_script` (0x33 PhysicsScript DID, parsed at `setup_model.rs:316`), but the static-render path (`statics.js`/`buildings.js`/`cells.js`) never reads it — only wire ObjectCreate entities run the chain (`entities.js:2229` → `_attachParticleChainForEntity` `:5715`). Retail runs it for EVERY physics object at creation (`acclient.c:320867` `if (setup->default_script_id.id) play_script_internal(...)`; state bit `0x80000` HAS_DEFAULT_SCRIPT_PS). → fountains/braziers/torches/smokestacks render as dead geometry. Holtburg example: `0x020004BE→0x330003EC`, `0x02000584→0x330003E9` (both continuous CreateParticle emitters). **Fix:** bake `default_script_id` into the scenery placement JSONL (DID already parsed Rust-side) + invoke the existing `_attachParticleChainForEntity` walker against placed static group nodes (anchor by world position, not entity GUID — statics have none). Requires a scenery re-bake to populate the field (operational; dist/scenery is machine-local/uncommitted).
**W1 — Scenery slope-rejection unit mismatch + inverted test (MED but LATENT — `--mode strict` bake only, S, flag-path).** `holtburger-scenery-bake/src/lib.rs:362-366` rejects in radians; retail `ObjectDesc::CheckSlope` (`acclient.c:351355`) tests `plane.N.z` (= cos(slope), 1.0=flat→0=vertical) `>= min_slope && <= max_slope`. 73.5% of rows (858/1167) have `min_slope>0` with values 0.86–0.98 (unmistakably cosines). The default `ace-compat` bake doesn't slope-reject (ACE never implements it — `Scenery.cs:69` TODO), so only `--mode strict` is wrong. **Fix:** compare terrain-normal Z (cosine) with the inequality retail uses. **W1b (LOW):** `align`/`orient` (parsed `object_desc.rs:83,85`, only 2.7%/3.4% of rows) → terrain-normal heading alignment (`acclient.c:352703 ObjAlign`); fold in only if doing strict-mode parity. **W1c (negligible):** authored pitch/roll dropped (0.69% of rows).
**Parallel-safe:** sole owner of statics/buildings/cells + scenery-bake crate; lib.rs region = scenery default_script export, disjoint from no one else (Agents B/C/D touch zero Rust).

### Agent B · ENTITIES — owns `scene3d/entities.js`
**C1 — Entity palette-path materials drop Surface render-state (MED, S, default-on).** The plain entity path (paletteId=0) routes through `MaterialCache`/`_materialFromFlags` and gets Tier-1 render-state; the **palette path** (dyed armor, skin/hair-tinted players, recolored creatures — `hasPaletteSubs`) builds raw `MeshStandardMaterial` inline (`entities.js:1905-1911` spawn, `:4883-4885` hot-swap), never reading `sp.surfaceType/.translucency/.luminosity` (all exposed: `lib.rs:5514/5552/5558`). → luminous/translucent/clipmap dyed gear & recolored creatures render flat-opaque/non-emissive. **Fix:** set `userData.surfaceTypeFlags = sp.surfaceType` + apply opacity/emissive from `sp.translucency`/`sp.luminosity` at both sites (or route through the existing `_materialFromFlags` — do NOT modify materials.js, Agent C owns it).
**A-DIR — AnimationHook direction-gate ignored (MED, S, default-on).** Wire `direction: i32` is parsed (`setup_model.rs:54`), baked to JS (`lib.rs:13234`; getter `:12289` admits "fires regardless of direction"), but `_fireHook`/`_fireHooksInRange` (`entities.js:6915-6934`) never reads it. Census: 6419 hooks = 3243 Both / 2976 Forward / **200 Backward**; 935 anims carry directional hooks. Forward-playing clips spuriously fire the 200 Backward-only hooks (dominated by SoundTable→wrong/double sounds; SetMaterial; TextureVelocity). Retail/ACE `Sequence.execute_hooks` gates `Direction==Both || ==dir` (`Sequence.cs:262`; `AnimationHookDir` Backward=-1/Both=0/Forward=1). **Fix:** skip a hook unless `direction==0` or it matches the segment's play direction; cheapest correct-enough default-on = drop `direction==-1` on the forward clips holtburger plays. NOT the 24-type dispatch (that's *what* hooks do; this is the per-hook fire/skip *gate*).
**Parallel-safe:** sole owner of entities.js; C1 + A-DIR are disjoint regions (~1905/4883 vs ~6915-6934). Reads materials.js/lib.rs (already-plumbed fields) but edits neither.

### Agent C · MATERIALS — owns `scene3d/materials.js`
**M1 — Alpha+Additive surfaces blend ONE/ONE instead of retail SRCALPHA/ONE (MED, HIGH for affected, S, default-on).** `_materialFromFlags` checks `if (isAdditive)` FIRST (`materials.js:1768`) → `AdditiveBlending` (ONE/ONE) for every additive surface, so the alpha-weighted branch is never reached for Alpha+Additive. Census: **183 surfaces are Alpha+Additive** (~90% of all additive) vs 19 pure-additive. Retail (`acclient.c:454470-454496`): Alpha bit → `SRCALPHA` src; `+Additive` → `ONE` dst (vs INVSRCALPHA). → spell glows/flame haloes over-brighten and show hard additive edges instead of alpha-weighted soft falloff. **Fix:** when `isAdditive && isAlpha` use `THREE.CustomBlending` {SrcAlphaFactor, OneFactor, AddEquation} + transparent/depthWrite:false; leave pure-additive on `AdditiveBlending`. **NON-gaps confirmed:** InvAlpha (0 in DAT), Stippled (0), Gouraud/Perspective/Detail (0), palette animation (doesn't exist), arbitrary UV-scroll (weather-only, W1-owned).
**Parallel-safe:** sole owner of materials.js. (Agent B's C1 may *call* `_materialFromFlags` at runtime — that's fine and composes correctly with M1's blend fix.)

### Agent D · LIGHTING — owns `scene3d/lighting.js`
**LG1 — Point-light intensity clamped to 8.0; retail lights are 20–100 (HIGH, S, default-on).** `lighting.js:382` `LIGHT_INTENSITY_CLAMP=8.0`, applied `:1171-1173`. Census of all 608 SetupModel lights: intensity min=20, p50=100, max=100 — **608/608 exceed 8**. Retail `calc_point_light` (`acclient.c:454615-454627`) multiplies by raw intensity then per-channel-clamps the contribution at the light's own color — high intensity is what saturates a torch to its warm color across most of its radius. The clamp crushes every lantern/brazier to ≤8–40% brightness AND defeats the shipped `?lightClamp=retail` per-channel clamp (which needs high intensity to saturate). The "rogue 9999" fear is unfounded (real data tops at 100). **Fix:** raise/remove the clamp (cap ~120, or pass raw and let R2.B's per-channel clamp bound it); tune at eye-test. **LG2 (LOW, DEFERRED):** retail `calc_point_light` uses a half-Lambert wrap (`(0.5·d + N·off)/1.5`, `acclient.c:454608`) vs stock `max(0,NdotL)` — fold into the `?lightClamp=retail` shader later; NOT this wave (would touch materials.js = Agent C).
**Parallel-safe:** sole owner of lighting.js. LG2 deferred precisely to avoid materials.js contention with Agent C.

## Cross-cutting coordination
- **Zero shared files this wave.** A=statics/buildings/cells+scenery-bake+lib.rs(scenery export); B=entities.js; C=materials.js; D=lighting.js. Only Agent A touches Rust → only Agent A's changes need a wasm rebuild (V1 export). C1/A-DIR/M1/LG1 are JS-only.
- **Default-on, fail-soft** for all five shipped items (V1, C1, A-DIR, M1, LG1). W1 is a non-default bake-mode fix. LG2/V2/W1b/W1c deferred as low.
- **V1 re-bake:** the scenery JSONL is machine-local/uncommitted; populating `default_script_id` needs a scenery re-bake (operational step, deferred to eye-test prep — agent implements the code, notes the re-bake).

## Confirmed NON-gaps — do NOT spend agent time (this sweep's additions)
`world_fog` (holtburger's `THREE.Fog` linear near/far is already retail-correct; retail `world_fog` is a per-keyframe on/off bool, not a fog-mode enum); InvAlpha 0x200 / Stippled / Gouraud / Perspective / Detail (census-zero in base DAT); palette-set animation (no time-based cycling in retail); light flicker/pulse (doesn't exist); spotlights (0/608 retail lights are cones); decals/scorch/bloodstains (no retail decal system; splatter is particle-only, shipped); `SetupModel.parent_index`/`anim_scale` (retail loads-but-ignores; absolute frames baked); clothing coverage/priority (server-authoritative ObjDesc); discrete frame-snap, reverse-segment baking, per-part rigid frames (faithful by design); `EnvironChange` ambient/fog presets (server GameEvent, not static render — separate audit).

## Suggested execution order
1. **Wave 3** (4 agents, parallel — disjoint files). 2. Rebuild wasm once (Agent A's lib.rs export) + bump `index.html` `?v=`. 3. (Operational) scenery re-bake to populate `default_script_id` for V1. 4. Eye-test on 1070: V1 ambient FX on props, LG1 interior glow, M1 spell-glow edges, C1 dyed-gear emissive, A-DIR no double-sounds.
